name: 12457-widedecode-8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 20480 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion (15360 scored).
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, FIXED lengths: prompt exactly 64 tokens (min = max = 64), output exactly 128 tokens (min = max = 128), greedy (`temperature: 0.0`). `request_format: plain` is required so that no chat template is applied and the engine sees exactly the declared 64 tokens. Output length is forced -- the `vllm_python` backend sets `ignore_eos` whenever `max_tokens` is set -- so every request generates exactly 128 tokens.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant generating fixed 128-token replies to short prompts for 1024 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
